generator.params.note: Hand-set from general knowledge of the species: a tall fir with a narrow, domed crown, level branches and flat sprays of long, glossy needles in two ranks. Not fitted to measurements.

allometry.note: Rough sizes from general knowledge of the species: 33 m tall and 50 cm across at breast height at 60 years in a closed stand. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.

appearance.note: Colours chosen by eye: glossy dark green needles; smooth grey bark with resin blisters, furrowed with age.

sources.title: Project After contributors: hand-set species values

provenance.notes: Procedural proxy from the step-6 catalogue, authored from general knowledge of the species in the south Puget Sound lowlands. Calibration against measurements and photographs is milestone P4.
